chapterInfo.content:
1
Habakuk nsɛmmisa
1Yeinom ne nsɛm a AWURADE yi kyerɛɛ Odiyifoɔ Habakuk:
2O AWURADE, menteam nkɔsi da bɛn ara
na wobɛtie me?
Nhyɛsoɔ nti mesu mefrɛ wo,
nanso wonnye me.
3Adɛn nti na woma mehunu abusudeɛ
ne ɔhaw sɛɛ, na wonyɛ ho hwee yi?
Ɔsɛeɛ ne nhyɛsoɔ da m’anim,
na ɔhaw ba, na akasaakasa asɔre.
4Enti mmara mu ago,
na atɛntenenee mfiri ara da,
ɛfiri sɛ abɔnefoɔ twa ɔteneneeni ho hyia,
enti atemmuo firi a, na akyea.
AWURADE maa Habakuk mmuaeɛ
5 # Aso 13.41 Monhwɛ amanaman mu na monhunu
na mo ho nnwiri mo dwiri pa ara,
na mereyɛ adwuma bi, mo nna mu,
wɔka kyerɛ mo a, morennye nni.
6Na hwɛ, merehwanyan Kaldeafoɔ,
ɔman a wɔn tirim yɛ den na wɔn ho yɛ hare
a wɔnante fa asase so nyinaa
fa tenabea a ɛnyɛ wɔn dea di soɔ.
7Wɔn ho yɛ ahomete ne hu,
wɔyɛ ahantanfoɔ a wɔyɛ deɛ wɔn ara wɔpɛ.
8 # Sef 3.3; Mat 24.28 Wɔn apɔnkɔ ho yɛ hare sene asebɔ,
na wɔyɛ aniɛden sene anwummerɛ mpataku,
na wɔn apɔnkɔsotefoɔ twetwe wɔn mu kɔ kan,
na wɔn apɔnkɔsotefoɔ firi akyirikyiri reba,
wɔtu sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔrepɛ adidie ho ntɛm.
9Wɔn nyinaa reba aturuturasɛmdie,
na wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛ apueeɛ fam anibereɛ so,
na wɔtase nnommum sɛ anwea.
10Wɔn deɛ, wɔsi ahemfo atwetweɛ
na aberempɔn ho yɛ wɔn sere,
wɔsere aban a ɛyɛ den nyinaa,
na wɔboa dɔteɛ ano gu hɔ na wɔafa.
11Ɛno na wɔtwam sɛ mframa, na wɔsene korɔ,
na wɔkɔdi so;
wɔn ahoɔden yi ara ne wɔn nyame.
Habakuk asɛmmisa a ɛtɔ so mmienu
12 # Yer 10.24 AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn ne me Kronkronni,
ɛnyɛ wo na wofiri tete nteredee?
AWURADE, wo ne ɔbotantim;
yɛrenwu na mmom wo ara na woahyɛ Kaldeafoɔ sɛ
wɔmmu yɛn atɛn na yɛn asotwe nti na wode wɔn asi hɔ.
13Wo a w’aniwa yɛ kronkron a wontumi nhwɛ bɔne
na wontumi nhwɛ ɔhaw,
adɛn nti na wohwɛ nkɔnkɔnsafoɔ,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ mene ɔteneneeni a ɔtene sene no a,
woyɛ komm?
14Afei nso, woayɛ nnipa sɛ ɛpo mu mpataa,
te sɛ mmoa a wɔwea a obi nni wɔn soɔ.
15Saa nti wɔde darewa atwe wɔn nyinaa,
wɔde asau twe wɔn,
na wɔboa wɔn ano, ne twiɛ mu;
yei nti wɔn ani gye na wɔn ho sɛpɛ wɔn.
16Ne saa nti, abɔnefoɔ bɔ n’asau no afɔdeɛ
na ɔhye aduhwam ma wɔn twiɛ no,
ɛfiri sɛ ɛno na ɛma ne kyɛfa dɔre sradeɛ,
na n’aduane yɛ sɔɔsɔɔ.
17Ɛno nti ɔnkɔ so ara mpore n’asau mu,
na ɔnkunkum amanaman daa nyinaa atirimuɔden so?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
